svg.title: Arquitectura de Despliegue AWS — SaludDeUna
svg.text: Arquitectura de Despliegue Objetivo — AWS Cloud
Deploy actual: Railway (backend) + Vercel (web) | Target: ECS Fargate rolling deploy sin downtime
Auto Scaling: min 2 tasks API, scale-out CPU>70% o mem>80% | IaC: Terraform (roadmap Q3 2026)
CI/CD: GitHub Actions → build → ECR push → ECS update-service --force-new-deployment | Secrets: AWS Secrets Manager
